methodologyNotes: Covers ceiling- and wall-mounted residential bathroom exhaust (ventilation) fans sold at a published US price, including models that bundle a light, humidity sensor, or nightlight. Excludes whole-house fans, inline duct fans with no room-side grille, range hoods, and commercial/industrial blowers. Price is typical US retail (MSRP) in USD. airflowCfm is the manufacturer's rated maximum airflow in cubic feet per minute (for multi-speed or Pick-A-Flow models, the highest selectable setting). noiseSones is loudness at rated airflow in sones, lower is quieter; null if not disclosed. maxCoverageAreaSqft is the largest bathroom floor area the maker rates the unit for, in square feet. ductDiameterIn is the outlet duct diameter in inches (typically 4 or 6). energyStarCertified is true only if the exact model carries ENERGY STAR certification. motorType is the enum 'DC' or 'AC'. wattageW is power draw at rated speed in watts. efficacyCfmPerWatt is rated airflow divided by watts (CFM per watt, higher is better); null if not disclosed. humiditySensor is true if a built-in humidity or condensation sensor is included. integratedLight is true if the fan ships with a built-in light. warrantyYears is the manufacturer warranty in years. mountType is the enum 'ceiling', 'wall', 'ceiling-wall', or 'inline'.
